episodes.name: Non Est Asylum
episodes.overviewEn: Seasoned demon hunter and master of the occult John Constantine takes on a rising darkness as he fights to reclaim his soul.

episodes.name: The Darkness Beneath
episodes.overviewEn: Deep in the mountains of Pennsylvania, John is a small mining community's only defense against an ancient Welsh spirit. John finds a vital new ally in a mysterious woman named Zed.

episodes.name: The Devil's Vinyl
episodes.overviewEn: John and Zed face down evil to save a woman and her family from sinister forces, forcing John to confront the darkness in his own life - and Papa Midnite.

episodes.name: A Feast of Friends
episodes.overviewEn: Constantine's old friend Gary Lester unleashes a powerful demon in Atlanta.

episodes.name: Danse Vaudou
episodes.overviewEn: Constantine forms an unholy alliance with Papa Midnite when a ritual turns deadly.

episodes.name: Rage of Caliban
episodes.overviewEn: When a young boy is taken over by a malevolent spirit, John must put aside his misgivings over exorcising a child and convince the parents that their boy is not all that he seems.

episodes.name: Blessed Are the Damned
episodes.overviewEn: Zed has a bizarre vision of snakes that leads her and John to a small town where a preacher has mysteriously gained the miraculous ability to heal his congregation.

episodes.name: The Saint of Last Resorts (1)
episodes.overviewEn: When an ancient evil surfaces in Mexico, an old friend of John's ends for his help bringing him close to the source of The Rising Darkness.

episodes.name: The Saint of Last Resorts (2)
episodes.overviewEn: In order to fend off a vicious attack, John summons a demon into himself. Chas, Zed and Anne Marie race against time to save John before it’s too late.

episodes.name: Quid Pro Quo
episodes.overviewEn: When thousands of people in New York slip into a mysterious coma, John must find the evil behind it and defeat it before it consumes the city.

episodes.name: A Whole World Out There
episodes.overviewEn: John helps his old University friend Ritchie Simpson, whose students have found a way into an alternate dimension only to unleash a maniacal killer.

episodes.name: Angels and Ministers of Grace
episodes.overviewEn: When John enlists an unwitting Manny to investigate an ancient evil that's resurfaced in a hospital, a health scare causes Zed to question the source of her visions.

episodes.name: Waiting for the Man
episodes.overviewEn: John and Zed return to New Orleans when Detective Jim Corrigan asks for their help in the case of a missing girl. Papa Midnite takes steps toward exacting his revenge on John and the truth behind the Rising Darkness comes to light.
